text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho puts on a brilliant
performance at
the Takarazuka Kinen
and takes first place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, we've made it through the
crucial first
two years of her career... and
a little bit more too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Shush, Familiar! Don't just randomly
shout like
that!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! You made me forget the new spell I
was
about to come up with!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And the time on that clock is wrong! It's
your job
as my familiar to fix things like
this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I rapidly adjust the clock, apologizing
profusely
to Sweep Tosho all the while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I can't simply slink away like some
useless
familiar. As her trainer, there's
something I need
to ask her about.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What next race?
choice_data_list: ところで次のレースはどうする？
choice_data_list_en: By the way, what are we doing about the next race?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I don't care about racing anymore. I've
already
used the most powerful racing
magic out there.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Be quiet!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A-hem! Racing magic isn't the only magic I want to learn, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Studying magic is a lot of work! Don't
you think
you should try being a little
more considerate of
me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rattle, rattle! WHAM!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Pardon meee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess, a spunky
Umamusume who
fights strength with
strength, comes barging in.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please teach me your racing magic!

Pleeeease!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...! You said "Huh"...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As in, "Huhve course!" Right?! Thank you
so much!
I owe you big time!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Pffft! As if, Kawadummy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I don't even have any plans to race right
now! So
my racing magic is currently
closed for business.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Shaddup, shaddup, shaddup!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: B-but... I require your magic! I mean, it's... It's...
choice_data_list_en: ï¼The volume of their voices, though...ï¼

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's the only thing that will change her
mind!
...Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wh-what're you crying for?! Ugh! Stop it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So why do you need my racing magic?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...I want someone to love racing.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
There's a certain person in your year that
I look
up to, and I want her to fall in
love with racing
again.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I had the chance to run with her
once—but only
once. I ran as hard as I
possibly could.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
She's an excellent runner, so I wanted to
win no
matter what.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The second the race started, I ran for
the front in
an attempt to push ahead. I
kept trying to push
out past her...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But then... I felt an impact.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...And I heard a quiet yelp. When I
turned around,
her face was completely
pale.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
She stopped right there and left the
track.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Shortly after that, I heard people saying
that
she'd become afraid of running.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I went and apologized to her as fast as I
could.
But she told me it wasn't my fault
and that I didn't
have anything to
apologize for.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But no matter how you look at it, it really was my fault!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Well...
choice_data_list: その先輩ってどのウマ娘？

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I heard you were taking a break after
you got hurt
in the Shuka Sho, but I see
you're feeling good
enough to go out on
partner runs already.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
S-Sweep?! Uh... um, it's nice to see you
again, I
guess.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is it true you're scared of running
now?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I've heard loads of rumors, but are they
really
true?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Oh, uh... Well...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: It's true.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Seriously?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
But not every single detail. Kawakami
really
didn't do anything wrong.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
All she did was compete the way anyone
would.
She didn't even bump me that
hard, and it didn't
even hurt.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
...It was my fault I stopped that day on
the track.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: How so?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: I just figured I couldn't do it.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
When I was out with my injury, I started
thinking
that, even if I recovered, I still
wouldn't be able
to...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...The heck?
Do what?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
Then, when I actually flinched during my
race with
Kawakami, I had proof. I was
just no match for
her.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: And after that...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
I saw you run in the Takarazuka Kinen.
You were
so amazing. I understood why
everyone called
your running magical.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
I knew I could never be as good as you,
so I
figured it was time to call it quits.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?! That's it? You watched me race, and that's what you thought?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Listen up—instead of saying you can't do
it
anymore, just give it another shot!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Run like you did in the Japanese Oaks
and the
Shuka Sh—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: I can't!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
...I'm just so scared. I don't want to lose

horrifically and have to face the fact that
I'm
really done for.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
I'm not the same as I used to be. Anyone
who gets
injured and takes a year off
gets left behind...
That's just the way
things are.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Just the way things are?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
How can you even say something so
lame?! I don't
get it! I don't get it at all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Who cares if that's how things are?!
Giving up
over something like that is so
unbelievably LAME!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
I can't help the way things are—it's just
life! I'm
not like you! I can't just make
miracles happen.
I'm just an ordinary—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Enough with that crap! Don't whine
about what's
normal or the way things
are. Just smash it all up
with magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come watch me race in the fall! I'll cast a
spell
that'll bring back the old you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's a pinky promise... From me to you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar! What G1 race can I run in
next?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think about which G1 races would be
good for
her, seeing as she's incredibly
motivated right
now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One comes to mind. It's a prestigious
race in the
fall that gathers the best of
the best. What's
more, it should be a
good fit for both her
distance aptitude
and late surging skills.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Okay, that'll work! Now, Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna use some really powerful magic at the autumn Tenno Sho, so make sure you drag you-know-who along to see it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I-I will!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(My amazing racing magic is going to
smash this
lame world to pieces and
drive everyone crazy.)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(No one is allowed to give up after
seeing my
magic! I'm just gonna have to
use an even bigger,
better spell this
time!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(And I'm gonna need a rival to do
that—someone
that'll help make our
special race super exciting
for
everyone...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy! Perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Sweep?! Good. I wanted to talk to you
too...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally convinced that you'd make
the perfect
rival! Run in the autumn
Tenno Sho with me!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...! The autumn Tenno Sho? You're
planning to run
there?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's right!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...! Hehe. Actually, I came here to ask
you to race
against me again.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to race against you. And this
time... I'm
going to win.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All right, you're gonna make the best
rival ever!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The world's gonna see the genius
Magical Girl
Sweepy use her best-ever
ultimate magic at this
year's autumn
Tenno Sho!
